name: APG-68-class radar, as DCS's F-16 tracked in practice
description: APG-68 with DCS's numbers (SIM_REV 24): the player's F-16 in DCS, its radar run with a narrowed TWS scan and the antenna on the target's altitude, first bugged an F-16 at 53-75 km (8 fights, 23 October), a few seconds after detection. Range randomised +-15% per episode as APG-68.

sources.MAX_RANGE: DCS, 23 October: first bugged track 52.8-75.3 km (mean 65.6) in 7 stick fights, the target in the scan and the antenna's coverage from further out; 65 km +-15% spans 55-75
sources.REF_RCS_M2: set equal to the F-16's RCS, so F-16 targets are detected at MAX_RANGE
sources.ACQUIRE_S: DCS, 23 October, 8 stick fights with the narrowed scan and the antenna aimed (dcs/stick/README.md): with the target in the scan and pressed for every 0.5 s, the bug came within a few seconds of first detection; 4 s
